verdict.rationale: Omnara's core purpose is delegating work to agents inside the product. Users launch agents from the dashboard (or CLI/API/SDK), follow progress live, send corrections, queue the next task, set which actions need approval, and interact through the dashboard or a first-party Slack connector. However, the agent is not a turnkey built-in assistant: users must define it in a YAML config and connect and grant a model provider before it can work. Missing for 10: a ready-made built-in assistant that needs no config or model setup, and independent hands-on corroboration of in-product task delegation on the current platform.
